worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.summary: Charge up, leap and slam into the target with an electric strike that knocks it back. Missing the target hurts the user.
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.descript: The charged drop deals about %1$s contact damage on a hit; the target's defence, Electric match-up and crits are settled when it lands.
Rise %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick, dive at %3$s blocks per tick with %4$s blocks per tick of forward drift.
Cast on an enemy within %1$s blocks, with a %2$s block discharge radius at the landing; if nothing is hit after the drop, the user takes %3$s of its own maximum health as self-hurt.
Charge level %1$s: each level adds 7% slam power, a faster dive and +1 percentage point of self-hurt, at +2 ticks of wind-up, +3 ticks of cooldown and 0.2 blocks less reach.
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.growth.0: From level %1$s the slam power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.growth.1: From level %1$s the slam power rises to %2$s and knockback to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.use.0: Deliver an Electric ranged strike with a charged drop
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.use.1: Dump a built charge to shove a target off you
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.use.2: Wear down a hard target with ranged Electric damage
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.preferen: Charge levels built before the leap: each level is +7% slam power, a faster dive and +0.01 self-hurt, at +2 ticks of wind-up, +3 ticks of cooldown and 0.2 blocks less reach. Level 0 is a quick light drop - farther, faster and lighter, but it does not shock hard.
Only drop on a target within this distance; closer in otherwise. Farther than the other crash kicks, for opening pressure.
Below this health ratio the user stops using Supercell Slam (a miss's self-hurt can be lethal). Higher is more cautious; lower takes more risk.
worldcombat.skill.supercellslam.descript: While rising, the landing point keeps tracking the target's live position; once the dive begins the point locks, so a target that strafes can slip away. Any non-allied living body struck on the way down is hit at once, settling a single target; if none is struck by the time it reaches the landing point, the nearest enemy within the discharge radius is taken instead; only a wholly empty drop, including hitting a wall on the way, counts as a miss.
